acceptanceCriteria: DCW-V0-019 is amended so a non-bootstrap hunk may stay `unknown` with a recorded reason; dogfood-change accepts such a plan and dogfood-check reports the unknown share instead of refusing.
A regression test shows a plan with one reasoned unknown hunk accepted and a plan with an unreasoned unknown hunk still refused.
docs/DOGFOOD.md and the workflow spec are updated in the same change; the kill condition text names the artifact that measures unknown share.
body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. Repro: run `make dogfood-change` with one non-bootstrap hunk left `unknown` in the citation plan; dogfood-change refuses the whole plan (docs/DOGFOOD.md section 4, DCW-V0-019). Expected: an `unknown` hunk with a one-line reason is accepted and the unknown share is reported. Actual: refusal. Effect: 99.8% `supported` over 591 committed maps is a workflow artifact and the `>30% unknown` kill condition in docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md cannot fire. Decision 0523 P3. Version: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 407.

completion.reason: Landed in PR beamfall/corvint#822 (merge 5aa02a8f1, on origin/main 1f35e3da): DCW-V0-019 amended and DCW-V0-046 added, reasoned unknown rows admitted, dogfood-check reports unknownShare, regression tests TestChangeDCWV0046AdmitsReasonedUnknownRefusesUnreasoned and siblings, docs/DOGFOOD.md and the CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP kill condition name the measuring artifact. Evidence note digest attached.

title: dogfood: DCW-V0-019 refuses any citation plan with a non-bootstrap `unknown` hunk, so the producer cannot express honest uncertainty
